newsitem.title: THAILAND: Krung Thai Bank to open Bombay branch.
newsitem.headline: Krung Thai Bank to open Bombay branch.

text.p: Thailand's state-owned Krung Thai Bank will open a branch in India's business city of Bombay on Friday, a bank executive said on Wednesday.
The new branch would be KTB's 12th offshore unit, Suwan Damneonthong, the bank's assistant vice-president, said in a statement.

The bank expected to break even within one year because of strong economic potential there, he said, adding that if the branch's performance met its target, KTB would consider opening a second branch in India.
"It could be New Delhi or any other appropriate location," he said.
KTB's other offshore branches are located in New York, Los Angeles, Phnom Penh, Vientiane, Singapore, Cayman islands and Kunming.
The bank also has representative offices in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Rangoon and Shanghai.
